title: Classification of exit openings.
officialText:
For the purposes of Section 1028.17, exit openings shall be classified as follows:
1. Class 1—Exit openings that are used for normal entry to the assembly space, and that open directly to a safe area or to an open exterior space.
2. Class 2—Exit openings that are not used for normal entry to the assembly space, and that open directly to a safe area or to an open exterior space.
3. Class 3—Exit openings that open from the assembly space into corridors, exit passageways or vertical exits.
